sandbox.lede: A sandbox is a box of its own on your wisp Grid for one piece of work: the agent can install, run and break anything there, never on this computer. Start one with /sandbox in New task; a delegate, a crew member's jobs or a goal's judges can run in one too. Each goes with what it was made for.
sandbox.signin.hint: Sandboxes run on your own subscription. Claude signs in once for all of them; Codex and the others sign in inside a sandbox, on its task's first turn.
sandbox.claude.off: Not signed in: /sandbox asks for this first
sandbox.env.hint: In every sandbox's environment, sealed on the grid. Values never come back here.
sandbox.step.make: Making your sandbox on the grid
sandbox.preparing.hint: About half a minute. You can leave this page: the task opens here and in your list once it's ready.
sandbox.signin.title: Sign in to Claude for sandboxes
sandbox.signin.lede: Sandboxes run Claude on your own subscription. Sign in once and every sandbox can use it: this task starts by itself as soon as you're in.
sandbox.signin.browser.hint: Claude's sign-in page is open. Approve it there and this task goes on by itself.
sandbox.signin.code: The page shows a code instead? Paste it here

sandbox.setup.failed.hint: Your project's .wisp/sandbox.sh exited with an error, so the task runs without what it sets up. The end of what it said:
